ulg.text: Kerrick, a Phyrexian sleeper agent trapped in a time bubble, claimed he had built an empire inside his tomb, as the sleepers had years to prepare while Tolaria had only minutes.

He found an eviscerator in the time bubble and knew he must unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it, building beasts from the parts of others as his corrupt domain swelled like a blister on Tolaria's skin.
He launched the Invasion of Tolaria while Urza was away, but Barrin activated a beacon and Urza returned to destroy him.
Multani, trapped within Urza, later helped destroy Kerrick and his Negators.
